typedef struct packed {
    logic WAIT;
    logic [31:0] RD;
} res_t;

typedef struct packed {
    logic valid;
    logic [31:0] A;
} req_t;

module origen_142912 #(
    parameter name = 0
) (
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst,
    input res_t res,
    output req_t req
);

    reg [31:0] counter;
    reg [31:0] dataExpect;
    reg dataValid;

    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            counter <= name;
            req.valid <= 0;
            req.A <= 0;
            dataValid <= 0;
        end else begin
            if (!res.WAIT) begin
                if (dataValid) begin
                    if (res.RD != dataExpect) begin
                        $display("init%0d got %0d, expected %0d !!! BAD!", name, res.RD, dataExpect);
                    end else begin
                        $display("init%0d got %0d as expected", name, res.RD);
                    end
                    dataValid <= 0;
                end

                if (counter[1:0] != 2'b11) begin
                    counter <= counter + 1;
                    req.valid <= 1;
                    req.A <= counter;
                    dataExpect <= counter;
                    dataValid <= 1;
                end else begin
                    req.valid <= 0;
                end
            end
        end
    end

endmodule
